title: LEGO Minifigure Production Keeps Building a Plastic Crowd
hook: This is not a headcount; it is decades of toys piling up.
closing: Cumulative production measures a manufacturing legacy, not how many plastic people remain in homes.
question: How many minifigures survived your house?

segments.say: Cumulative LEGO minifigure production reached 10 billion. That counts every figure ever made, not toys still in circulation.
The cumulative total was 4 billion in 2010. More than half the recorded pile came afterward.
LEGO makes 400 million minifigures yearly. The plastic crowd keeps growing because production never stopped.
